name: PCI Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: PCI Technology Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides software and information technology services in China. It offers enterprise digital transformation and upgrade, smart city cluster integrated transportation, smart city rail transit communication, and smart city traffic management solutions. Additionally, it offers multispectral pantograph-catenary inspection system; a rail magnetic flux leakage inspection system for detecting surface and near-surface defects; a rail break monitoring system; and a portable rail temperature; and stress measurement device.
